Installing a dust or fume extraction system is just the start. 🛠️ Effective extraction plays an important ongoing role in managing airborne contaminants and supporting workplace health and safety — but only if it keeps performing the way it was designed to. Burwell Environmental Division supports customers well beyond installation day, with replacement filters, preventative maintenance, technical support and system upgrades — for Burwell equipment and suitable systems from other manufacturers. Learn more about our service and aftermarket support at burwell.com.au/environmental-division #BurwellEnvironmental #WorkplaceSafety #DustAndFumeExtraction #PreventativeMaintenance #IndustrialServicing #WHS
